preconditions.name: oracle_clears_floor_all_rungs
preconditions.description: The greedy nearest-resource ORACLE must clear COMPETENCE_RESOURCE_FLOOR resources/episode at EACH difficulty rung, proving the floor is ACHIEVABLE in that env. Same statistic as the load-bearing recovery criterion (mean resources/episode). Below-floor at a rung => that cell is not ready; below-floor at D0 => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a ceiling verdict.
preconditions.control: greedy nearest-resource oracle forager per rung, same env/seed, no agent

preconditions.name: baseline_reproduces_incompetence_at_D0
preconditions.description: The all-ON stack trained on the D0 (=724) env must forage BELOW the floor on a strict majority of seeds -- i.e. the 724/728 incompetence must reproduce -- for the sweep premise to hold. If it already clears the floor at D0 the premise is not reproduced => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: ree_trained_allon D0 mean resources/ep vs floor (strict majority of seeds)

preconditions.name: hazard_free_rung_achievable
preconditions.description: The maximally de-risked D3 (hazard-free) env must be oracle-achievable (oracle clears the floor) so that 'neither learner recovers even hazard-free' can license the deepest learner/observability branch rather than an env-too-hard artifact.
preconditions.control: greedy oracle on D3 hazard-free env vs floor

preconditions.name: sufficient_eval_episodes_all_cells
preconditions.description: Every completed cell must log >= MIN_EVAL_EPISODES eval episodes so foraging_competence is estimable. Below => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: min completed eval episodes across all cells
